#!/usr/bin/env python3
import socket
import sys
import time
import select

def main():
    # Connect to the serial socket
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
    s.connect('/tmp/qemu-serial.sock')
    s.setblocking(0)
    
    print("Connected to QEMU serial socket")
    
    # Read loop
    start_time = time.time()
    while time.time() - start_time < 30:  # 30 second timeout
        ready, _, _ = select.select([s], [], [], 1)
        if ready:
            try:
                data = s.recv(4096)
                if data:
                    sys.stdout.write(data.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore'))
                    sys.stdout.flush()
            except:
                pass
    
    s.close()
    print("\nTimeout - exiting")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
PYEOF

import socket
import time
import sys

def send_data(sock, data, delay=0.5):
    """Send data to socket and wait"""
    sock.send(data.encode())
    time.sleep(delay)

def read_socket(sock, timeout=2):
    """Read data from socket"""
    sock.setblocking(0)
    try:

        if data:
            return data
    except:

    return ""
